annotations.title: Find failure precedents for an existing app

description: Analyze an existing app using observed behavior, README, architecture notes, configuration or source snippets. Provide a public GitHub repository_url to import selected context, or inspect a private repository locally and submit relevant text. Code is never executed and the running app is not scanned. Returns source context, behavior signals, historical precedents and safeguards to verify.

files.description: Relevant text files. Description plus file contents must fit within 25,000 characters and the 32 KB request limit. Remove credentials and personal data.

proposal.description: Observed app behavior, integrations, data flows, permissions and deployment context. Optional when files are supplied.

repository_url.description: Public GitHub repository home URL, e.g. https://github.com/owner/app. Imports a small selection of docs, config and source at one commit.

name: analyze_existing_app
title: Find failure precedents for an existing app
